# x402 Router
> Find a working x402 (HTTP 402 pay-per-call) API in one request. 20,700+ LIVE endpoints, probed every 3h, validated 402 bodies, 0-100 reliability score. Free JSON, no auth.

## Quick start for agents
1. Search: GET https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/dashboardapi/endpoints?q=<task>&chain=Base&min_score=90&sort=score&limit=10
2. Or one best match: POST https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/route {"q":"<task>","chain":"Base","max_price":0.05}
3. Call the returned target_url with your x402 client; it answers 402 with payment terms.

## APIs
- [Endpoint search](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/dashboardapi/endpoints): filters q, chain, category, max_price, min_score, sort (score|price|latency|newest), page, limit<=500
- [Summary](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/dashboardapi/summary): counts by chain, category, source
- [Full registry](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/dashboardapi/registry): paginated, or full gzip
- [Router OpenAPI](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/openapi.json)
- [x402 discovery](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/.well-known/x402)
- [Paid route](https://router-production-ab89.up.railway.app/route/paid): $0.01 USDC on Base (Solana accepted), returns best match

## MCP
Tools search_x402_endpoints, route_x402_request, get_registry_stats (Python server, stdio + HTTP).
